tasks.gr12-work-energy-power-t2: Topic: Work, energy and power. Cover work done by a force, the work-energy theorem, conservation of mechanical energy, gravitational potential energy, kinetic energy, average power and the power relationship P = Fv. Ask Grade 12 learners to calculate work and power, recognise positive and negative work, and solve mechanics problems involving energy changes.
tasks.gr12-doppler-effect-applications-t2: Topic: Doppler effect. Cover frequency changes caused by moving sources or observers, pitch changes, interpreting whether source and listener are moving together or apart, ultrasound applications, red shift and the expanding universe. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain everyday sound scenarios and astronomy or medical Doppler applications.
tasks.gr12-rates-equilibrium-acids-bases-t2: Topic: Reaction rates, equilibrium and acids/bases. Cover collision theory, activation energy, catalysts, factors affecting reaction rate, dynamic equilibrium, Le Chateliers principle, equilibrium constant ideas, Arrhenius and Brønsted-Lowry acid-base theories, pH, strong and weak acids, and hydrolysis of salts. Ask learners to explain rate changes, predict equilibrium shifts and solve core pH questions.
